//Regional: Overrides the country preset for this installation. Everything omitted falls back to
the preset named by Country, and a company hosted through the operator portal is
PricesIncludeTax is the one setting a trading business almost always has to decide
deliberately, and since 2026-09-25 the Algeria preset ships false: prices are stored
before tax and a taxed document adds the rate on top. That is what a contracting or
wholesale business quotes. A shop pricing shelf goods to walk-in customers sets true
The setting does not reprice anything: it changes what the stored number *means*. At
false, a product at 12000 means the customer pays 12000 + 2280 = 14280. At true the
same product means the customer pays 12000 with 1916 of tax already inside it. Check
which the price list is before overriding this.
